done_when: A test broadcast with an allowlisted cmd, sent while only the loop runs on a host, is executed once and acked done within 15 minutes; a non-allowlisted cmd is not run and shows in mts_doctor BROADCAST; tests cover failure, repeat-run and restart.
goal: A host that runs the live `mts_run loop` but no Claude session (the Lenovo) acks and runs HIGH broadcast commands that are on an allowlist, so a broadcast no longer waits for a session that never comes.
note: Operator 2026-10-25: broadcast is a feature that needs immediate acknowledgement. Guardrails shipped (told expires after 2 h; pending verb; mts_doctor BROADCAST). This card is the LIVE-PATH half and was deliberately left out of that ship. Approach: allowlist file MyTradingSys/system/BROADCAST_CMD_ALLOWLIST.json of exact command strings or regexes (e.g. `python scripts/dev/c_drive_guard.py install`); each loop tick (low frequency, e.g. every 10 min) runs `mts_signal.py pending --host <h> --json`, runs a cmd only when it matches the allowlist exactly, with a timeout, no shell metacharacters, logging to runtime_data/broadcast_cmds.log, then `ack <id> done --note` (or `told --note <exit code/blocker>` on failure). A cmd not on the allowlist is never run: it stays pending so mts_doctor BROADCAST warns. Fail closed: any parse/network error skips the tick; never touches orders, HALT files or the trading loop state. Live-path rules apply: tests for restart/reset state, non-trade balance moves and API errors; deploy only by the manual runbook.
scope_in: live loop tick hook (find with grep mts_run loop)
scope_out: executing any cmd not on the allowlist
changing ack semantics (told TTL stays 2 h)
steps: Write the allowlist file and a loader that fails closed
Add a loop-tick function calling pending --host --json and running only allowlisted cmds
Write the five tests, then hand the deploy to the manual runbook
tests: New tests: allowlisted cmd runs once; non-allowlisted never runs; failing cmd acks told with note; restart does not rerun a done id; network error skips the tick.
title: loop-runs-broadcast-cmds: live loop executes allowlisted HIGH broadcast cmds on hosts with no session
